LESSON: MEDICINAL TREES

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation (Srishti)
Topic 1.2: Medicinal Trees

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Medicinal Trees. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How are medicinal plants beneficial to mankind?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the right use of medicinal plants for safe use
2. appreciate the use of medicinal plants for good health
3. name the Enlightened Beings for familiarisation
4. identify the contributions of Enlightened Beings for spiritual well- being
5. appreciate the teachings of Enlightened Beings for peaceful living

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: MEDICINAL TREES
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 5
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Medicinal Trees helps you succeed in HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: MEDICINAL TREES
Study Medicinal Trees like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Identify the right use of medicinal plants for safe use

What this means
In this part you learn to identify the right use of medicinal plants for safe use. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify the right use of medicinal plants for safe use.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Medicinal Trees” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify the right use of medicinal plants for safe use. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Appreciate the use of medicinal plants for good health

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the use of medicinal plants for good health. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the use of medicinal plants for good health.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Medicinal Trees in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the use of medicinal plants for good health. Write or say your answer clearly.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: name the Enlightened Beings for familiarisation.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can name the Enlightened Beings for familiarisation. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Identify the contributions of Enlightened Beings for spiritual well- being

What this means

How to learn it

2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify the contributions of Enlightened Beings for spiritual well- being. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 5: Appreciate the teachings of Enlightened Beings for peaceful living

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the teachings of Enlightened Beings for peaceful living. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the teachings of Enlightened Beings for peaceful living.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Medicinal Trees in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the teachings of Enlightened Beings for peaceful living. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Medicinal Trees is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Medicinal Trees” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: identify the right use of medicinal plants for safe use)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Medicinal Trees in your own words. (skill: appreciate the use of medicinal plants for good health)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: name the Enlightened Beings for familiarisation)

Example 4: Show how “Medicinal Trees” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: identify the contributions of Enlightened Beings for spiritual well- being)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Medicinal Trees to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify the right use of medicinal plants for safe use.
3. Practise this skill: appreciate the use of medicinal plants for good health.
4. Practise this skill: name the Enlightened Beings for familiarisation.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Medicinal Trees from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Medicinal Trees: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 5 learner study Medicinal Trees?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How are medicinal plants beneficial to mankind?
2. Why is it necessary to use medicinal plants appropriately ?
3. Why is it important to nurture medicinal plants?
4. How do Enlightened Beings contribute to social welfare?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Medicinal Trees means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify the right use of medicinal plants for safe use.
5. Be able to: appreciate the use of medicinal plants for good health.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
